senses.meaning: Cổ tay áo, măng-sét (phần cuối ống tay áo)
examples: He rolled up his shirt cuffs before washing the dishes.
The jacket has elegant gold buttons on the cuffs.
Her cuffs were frayed from years of wear.

senses.meaning: Tát nhẹ, đánh bằng lòng bàn tay
examples: She cuffed him playfully on the shoulder.
He cuffed the dog lightly to stop it barking.
The older boy cuffed his younger brother on the arm.

note: 'Off the cuff' = ứng khẩu, không chuẩn bị trước.

senses.meaning: Mũ trùm đầu gắn liền với áo; nắp ca-pô xe hơi
examples: She pulled her hood up against the rain.
He opened the car's hood to check the engine.
The hoodie gets its name from the hood sewn into it.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng 'hood' cho nắp ca-pô; tiếng Anh Anh dùng 'bonnet'.

senses.meaning: Cổ áo; vòng cổ thú cưng
examples: He loosened his collar after a long day in the office.
The dog wore a red leather collar with a name tag.
Her dress had a wide lace collar.

senses.meaning: Tóm cổ, bắt giữ; chặn lại để nói chuyện
examples: Police collared the suspect near the train station.
My boss collared me in the corridor to ask about the report.
Security guards collared the shoplifter at the exit.

senses.meaning: Vải flannel, vải dạ mềm mịn
examples: He wore a warm flannel shirt on the hiking trip.
The baby's blanket was made of soft flannel.
Flannel pajamas are popular in the colder months.

senses.meaning: Vải, hàng dệt; ngành dệt may
examples: The country exports cotton and other textiles.
She studied the history of textile production in her thesis.
Silk is one of the most luxurious textiles in the world.

senses.meaning: Thuộc về/liên quan đến ngành dệt may
examples: The textile industry employs thousands of workers in this region.
She works in a textile factory on the outskirts of town.
Textile exports have grown significantly this year.
